feat: v0.7 Simplified Inventory System

- Add 3 new tables: player_inventory, company_inventory, aircraft_inventory
- Production \(complete_batch\) now writes directly to company_inventory
- Add simplified endpoints: /inventory/player, /inventory/company, /inventory/aircraft/{id}
- Add load/unload cargo endpoints for aircraft transport
- Update documentation with V0.7 Simplified changes
- Keep legacy tables \(inventory_locations, inventory_items\) for T0/NPC and HV

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: v0.8.2 Mission System & EFB Market Tab

Mission System:
- New missions router with full CRUD operations
- Mission model with cargo snapshot, scoring, anti-cheat
- Auto-start missions \(status: in_progress on create\)
- Scoring system: landing, g-force, destination, time, fuel
- Grade calculation \(S to F\) and XP rewards
- Cheat detection \(payload verification at 500ft\)
- Cargo transfer to destination on completion

EFB Tablet:
- Market tab with listings from HV \(Hotel des Ventes\)
- Wallet display \(personal + company\)
- Tier filters \(T0, T1, T2, T3\)
- Buy popup with quantity slider and wallet selection
- Coherent GT refs + innerHTML pattern for dynamic lists

API Updates:
- Missions endpoints: create, start, complete, fail, list
- Fleet cargo load/unload with weight validation
- World airports with coords and helipad support

Documentation:
- EFB tablet guide with Market section
- Market docs with EFB integration
- Mission system specs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
